items.source: Provider for synchronous stateless MCP tool methods. This provider creates tool specifications for methods annotated with McpTool that are designed to work in a stateless manner using McpTransportContext.
items.translation: 同步无状态 MCP 工具方法的提供者。 此提供者为使用 McpTransportContext 以无状态方式工作的、带有 McpTool 注解的方法创建工具规范。

items.source: toolObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpTool
items.translation: toolObjects - 包含用 McpTool 注解的方法的对象
